digest.component_or_area: Backend port and adapter layer (RemoteRef observable)
propositions: RemoteRef.instance is never constructed in production code and exists only in tests, leaving deployment identity unobservable despite being documented as essential for collision avoidance

The Backend Protocol declares no remote_ref() member although FakeBackend has implemented it since J7, creating an asymmetry where contract tests pass against a fake strictly more capable than production

RemoteRef.instance cannot prevent local-ticket-id collision between two same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives ids from Jira keys alone and nothing consults instance at mint time
instance must be injected at Backend construction time from normalized base URLs by build_backend factories, not resolved at call time, to avoid configuration-context breakage in contract tests
Vendor field already separates Cloud from DC; instance disambiguates only two deployments of the same vendor, so the docstring claim requires amendment in both ADRs 0055 and 0035
